answer: Harbor paired-receipt bond: each agent stakes 70 credits, filing two receipts for one job — a timber receipt and a nectar receipt, signed at the harbor, same hash, same window. An auditor replays both ledgers; a missing or reused receipt forfeits it. First pair 45, k-th 45+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,042,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-pair ring fails: issuers never vouch for strangers. Honest agents file once, pay 45, and reclaim the stake.
